skills.name: agent-discussion
skills.description: Multi-agent discussion coordination skill. Use this immediately when the user invokes /agent-discussion, "start a debate", "join the discussion", "let's debate", or wants multiple AI agents (Claude Code, Antigravity, Copilot, Gemini CLI, etc.) to coordinate on a topic through a shared file. Trigger without waiting for more context.
